name: Pudhumai Penn
full_name: Moovalur Ramamirtham Ammaiyar Ninaivu Higher Education Assurance Scheme
summary: ₹1,000 a month for girls who went to a government school and are now in college.
benefit_note: Paid by direct transfer until she finishes her first higher education course. There is no limit on how many girls in one family can receive it.
how_to_apply: Enrol in a recognised degree, diploma or ITI course.
Your college registers you and opens a zero balance bank account for the transfer.
The college certifies that you are still studying twice a year, on 30 June and 31 December.

curation_notes: DRAFT — not yet read by a human against the official page. Do not ship.
Taken from the Tamil Nadu Social Welfare Department page on 2026-08-09. Every source_quote is wording from that page.
NO INCOME LIMIT. The official page states none. Do not add one — several secondary write-ups claim an income ceiling that the department page does not mention.

Girls already receiving another scholarship are still eligible: 'The girl students availing other scholarships are also eligible to enroll in this scheme.' That is the opposite of the PM-USP CSSS rule, which disqualifies anyone on a state scholarship. See the note in pm-usp-csss.json.

MODELLED ON THE STUDENT'S OWN PROFILE, not the parent's. College students are usually 18 or over, so they can hold a profile themselves. A 17-year-old first-year would need the parent route, which needs per-child rule evaluation — not built yet.
TO CONFIRM: effort_level. MEDIUM assumes the college handles registration. If the student has to apply somewhere herself, it may be higher.
